pairs.en_para: Only sometimes I find a conflict between family people. Your priority should be sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga. Say a husband may not be equally interested in sahaja yoga and the wife is pulled down. She should show that her interest is sahaja yoga nothing else and he will come. She should not give way to him. And if he is so that he wants to get into sahaja yoga and she objects. She has no business to do that under any divine law she has no business to do that. If she tries that, husband need not listen to her at all he should go full ahead. Because ultimately he is an important part of sahaja yoga. And he should not in any way make the importance less. So she should go ahead with what she wants. If he is a sahaja yogi he should not bother about anything. His family will be blessed, everybody will be blessed, if he is there.
pairs.zh_para: 有时我发现家庭成员之间会有冲突。你们的优先级应该是萨哈佳瑜伽、萨哈佳瑜伽、萨哈佳瑜伽。假设丈夫对萨哈佳瑜伽的兴趣不如妻子浓厚，导致妻子情绪低落。她应该表现出她的兴趣仅在于萨哈佳瑜伽，别无其他，这样他自然会加入。她不应向他妥协。反之，如果丈夫想要投身萨哈佳瑜伽而妻子反对，根据任何神圣法则，她都没有权利这样做。如果她试图阻止，丈夫完全不必听她的，他应该全力以赴地前进。因为归根结底，他是萨哈佳瑜伽的重要组成部分。他绝不应以任何方式削弱其重要性。因此，她应坚持自己的意愿前行。如果他是萨哈佳瑜伽士，他就不应被任何事困扰。只要他在，他的家庭将得到祝福，所有人都会得到祝福。

sentences.en: Only sometimes I find a conflict between family people.
sentences.zh: 有时我发现家庭成员之间会有冲突。

sentences.en: Your priority should be sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga.
sentences.zh: 你们的优先级应该是萨哈佳瑜伽、萨哈佳瑜伽、萨哈佳瑜伽。

sentences.en: Say a husband may not be equally interested in sahaja yoga and the wife is pulled down.
sentences.zh: 假设丈夫对萨哈佳瑜伽的兴趣不如妻子浓厚，导致妻子情绪低落。

sentences.en: She should show that her interest is sahaja yoga nothing else and he will come.
sentences.zh: 她应该表现出她的兴趣仅在于萨哈佳瑜伽，别无其他，这样他自然会加入。

sentences.en: She should not give way to him.
sentences.zh: 她不应向他妥协。

sentences.en: And if he is so that he wants to get into sahaja yoga and she objects.
sentences.zh: 反之，如果丈夫想要投身萨哈佳瑜伽而妻子反对，

sentences.en: She has no business to do that under any divine law she has no business to do that.
sentences.zh: 根据任何神圣法则，她都没有权利这样做。

sentences.en: If she tries that, husband need not listen to her at all he should go full ahead.
sentences.zh: 如果她试图阻止，丈夫完全不必听她的，他应该全力以赴地前进。

sentences.en: Because ultimately he is an important part of sahaja yoga.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，他是萨哈佳瑜伽的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: And he should not in any way make the importance less.
sentences.zh: 他绝不应以任何方式削弱其重要性。

sentences.en: So she should go ahead with what she wants.
sentences.zh: 因此，她应坚持自己的意愿前行。

sentences.en: If he is a sahaja yogi he should not bother about anything.
sentences.zh: 如果他是萨哈佳瑜伽士，他就不应被任何事困扰。

sentences.en: His family will be blessed, everybody will be blessed, if he is there.
sentences.zh: 只要他在，他的家庭将得到祝福，所有人都会得到祝福。

pairs.en_para: So any excuses, that takes you away from sahaja yoga are not helpful to the family. Because if the deities are angry your family will be harmed. If say, a woman is a sahaja-yogini and her family people object to it they will be harmed and she will be harmed as well. But if she is in sahaja yoga all the family will be saved. So, you are doing a greater, you are doing a greater service to your family by becoming a sahaja yogi and a true sahaja yogi and a dedicated and devoted sahaja yogi.
pairs.zh_para: 因此，任何让你远离萨哈佳瑜伽的借口都对家庭无益。因为如果神灵愤怒，你的家庭将受到伤害。假如一位女性是萨哈佳瑜伽尼（sahaja-yogini），而她的家人反对，那么他们和她自己都将受到伤害。但如果她坚守萨哈佳瑜伽，整个家庭都将得救。所以，通过成为一名萨哈佳瑜伽士、真正的萨哈佳瑜伽士以及全心全意奉献的萨哈佳瑜伽士，你正在为家庭做出更大的服务。

sentences.en: So any excuses, that takes you away from sahaja yoga are not helpful to the family.
sentences.zh: 因此，任何让你远离萨哈佳瑜伽的借口都对家庭无益。

sentences.en: Because if the deities are angry your family will be harmed.
sentences.zh: 因为如果神灵愤怒，你的家庭将受到伤害。

sentences.en: If say, a woman is a sahaja-yogini and her family people object to it they will be harmed and she will be harmed as well.
sentences.zh: 假如一位女性是萨哈佳瑜伽尼（sahaja-yogini），而她的家人反对，那么他们和她自己都将受到伤害。

sentences.en: But if she is in sahaja yoga all the family will be saved.
sentences.zh: 但如果她坚守萨哈佳瑜伽，整个家庭都将得救。

sentences.en: So, you are doing a greater, you are doing a greater service to your family by becoming a sahaja yogi and a true sahaja yogi and a dedicated and devoted sahaja yogi.
sentences.zh: 所以，通过成为一名萨哈佳瑜伽士、真正的萨哈佳瑜伽士以及全心全意奉献的萨哈佳瑜伽士，你正在为家庭做出更大的服务。

pairs.en_para: But no individualistic efforts, no individualistic attitude is helpful to Me or to sahaja yoga, is very detrimental under any name under any banner under any excuse. Try to find out ways and methods of becoming one with others. If you want to find out faults with others there can be any, I mean I should not be here. I can say that. Then I should not be on this earth. I could have said that. But I see that spirit in you, and I see that beauty in you. I don’t see other things. If I had not seen that spirit I would not have worked like this.
pairs.zh_para: 但是，任何个人主义的努力或个人主义的态度，无论以何种名义、何种旗帜或何种借口，对我或萨哈佳瑜伽都毫无助益，反而极具危害性。试着寻找与他人合一的途径和方法。如果你想要找出他人的过错，那随时都可以找到，我的意思是说我本不该在这里。我可以这么说。那我本不该存在于这地球上。我本可以这样说。但我看到了你们身上的那种精神，我看到了你们身上的那种美。我不看其他东西。如果我没有看到那种精神，我就不会像现在这样工作。

sentences.en: But no individualistic efforts, no individualistic attitude is helpful to Me or to sahaja yoga, is very detrimental under any name under any banner under any excuse.
sentences.zh: 但是，任何个人主义的努力或个人主义的态度，无论以何种名义、何种旗帜或何种借口，对我或萨哈佳瑜伽都毫无助益，反而极具危害性。

sentences.en: Try to find out ways and methods of becoming one with others.
sentences.zh: 试着寻找与他人合一的途径和方法。

sentences.en: If you want to find out faults with others there can be any, I mean I should not be here.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要找出他人的过错，那随时都可以找到，我的意思是说我本不该在这里。

sentences.en: I can say that.
sentences.zh: 我可以这么说。

sentences.en: Then I should not be on this earth.
sentences.zh: 那我本不该存在于这地球上。

sentences.en: I could have said that.
sentences.zh: 我本可以这样说。

sentences.en: But I see that spirit in you, and I see that beauty in you.
sentences.zh: 但我看到了你们身上的那种精神，我看到了你们身上的那种美。

sentences.en: I don’t see other things.
sentences.zh: 我不看其他东西。

sentences.en: If I had not seen that spirit I would not have worked like this.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有看到那种精神，我就不会像现在这样工作。
